preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(3 <= N <= 1000 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin_text.splitlines() if line.strip() and not any(c.isdigit() for c in line) or (line.strip() and all(c in '01' for c in line.strip()) == False)])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the length N is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(S) == len(P) == N for N, S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, the lengths of S and P are equal to N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in S) and all(c in '01' for c in P) for N, S, P in test_cases)
preconditions.description: S and P consist only of binary characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: all(output_lines[i] in ['YES', 'yes', 'Yes', 'yEs', 'yeS', 'yES', 'YES', 'No', 'no', 'NO', 'nO', 'No', 'nO'] for i in range(len(output_lines)))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a case-insensitive 'YES' or 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: all((output_lines[i].upper() == 'YES') == (not (S_count_0 == 0 or S_count_1 == 0) and not (P_count_0 == 0 or P_count_1 == 0)) for i, (N, S, P) in enumerate(test_cases) for S_count_0, S_count_1, P_count_0, P_count_1 in [(S.count('0'), S.count('1'), P.count('0'), P.count('1'))])
postconditions.description: Output is YES if and only if both S and P contain at least one '0' and at least one '1'; otherwise output is NO.
